description.en: UAS.LUC.020(5) and (6) list what an LUC holder keeps for operations under its privileges: the risk assessment and its supporting documents, the mitigations taken, and the qualifications and experience of the people involved in operations, compliance monitoring and safety management. Each is kept at least three years, and personnel records for the person's employment and three years after they leave. EASA's guidance starts the clock when a record is created or last amended.

evidenceHint.en: Record schedule listing each LUC record type, its owner, its storage location and its retention rule

text.en: List each record type UAS.LUC.020(5) and (6) requires for operations under the privileges.
Name an owner and a storage location for each record type.
Set the retention for each, counting three years from creation or last amendment.
Set personnel records to run for the employment and three years after the person leaves.

title.en: Store LUC records so they are protected from damage, alteration and theft

description.en: Records must be kept in a way that protects them from damage, alteration and theft, and, in EASA's guidance, organised so they can be traced and retrieved within a reasonable time when the authority asks, with adequate backups. Choose storage with access controls and change logging, back it up to a separate location, and make sure retrieval does not depend on one person.

evidenceHint.en: Storage configuration showing access controls, change logging and backup arrangements, and the restore test result

text.en: Choose storage with access controls that limit who can change or delete records.
Turn on logging of changes to stored records.
Back records up to a separate location on a set schedule.
Test restoring a record from backup and record the result.
Document how records are retrieved so retrieval does not depend on one person.

title.en: Hold LUC personnel qualification and experience records until three years after leaving

description.en: Hold the qualification and experience records of everyone involved in operations, compliance monitoring and safety management for as long as they work for the organisation and for three years after they leave. Tie the leaver process to the record schedule, so a departure starts the retention clock instead of an archive clean-up removing the records early.

evidenceHint.en: Personnel record file per person with qualifications and experience, and leaver entries showing the retention end date

text.en: Open a qualification and experience record for each person in operations, compliance or safety.
Update each record when a person gains a qualification or changes role.
Record the leaving date and set the retention end date three years later.
Block deletion of personnel records before their retention end date.

title.en: Send a digital acknowledgement when the LUC is surrendered or revoked

description.en: UAS.LUC.080(2) requires the LUC holder, on revocation or surrender of the certificate, to provide a digital acknowledgement returned to the competent authority without delay. Prepare the procedure in advance: who sends the acknowledgement, how every operation relying on the privileges is stopped at once, and how the records are kept for their remaining retention period.

evidenceHint.en: Revocation and surrender procedure, and for any actual event the dated digital acknowledgement sent to the competent authority

text.en: Name who sends the digital acknowledgement on revocation or surrender.
Stop every operation relying on the LUC privileges the same day.
Return the digital acknowledgement to the competent authority without delay.
Keep the LUC records for the rest of their retention period.

title.en: Assess the LUC's continuing validity against the regulation and the issuing State each year

description.en: An LUC has unlimited duration but stays valid only while the holder complies with the regulation and the requirements of the State that issued it, and while it is neither surrendered nor revoked (UAS.LUC.080(1)). Once a year, assess continuing compliance across Part C, Part B duties and any national requirement of the issuing State, and act on what the assessment finds.

evidenceHint.en: Annual validity self-assessment covering Part C, the Part B duties and the issuing State's requirements, with actions and owners

text.en: List the requirements of Part C, the Part B duties and the issuing State that apply.
Assess compliance with each, using the year's audit findings and records.
Record any gap that could put the LUC's validity at risk.
Agree actions with owners and due dates and report them to the accountable manager.

packs.name: Open category A1: over people (class C0, C1)
packs.description: Flights with class C0 or C1 aircraft, privately built or legacy aircraft under 250 g, where uninvolved people may be overflown briefly but assemblies never are. Installs the controls every operation needs, the open-category controls and the A1 controls.

packs.name: Open category A2: close to people (class C2)
packs.description: Flights with a class C2 aircraft close to, but never over, uninvolved people: at least 30 m away, or 5 m in low-speed mode. Needs the A2 certificate of remote pilot competency. Installs the controls every operation needs, the open-category controls and the A2 controls.

packs.name: Open category A3: far from people (class C2, C3, C4)
packs.description: Flights far from people, at least 150 m from residential, commercial, industrial and recreational areas, with class C2, C3 or C4 aircraft or privately built or legacy aircraft under 25 kg. Installs the controls every operation needs, the open-category controls and the A3 controls.

packs.name: Class C2 drone: open category A2 and A3
packs.description: Everything an operator needs to fly a class C2 aircraft in the open category, which it may do in subcategory A2 (close to people, with the A2 certificate) or A3 (far from people). Installs the A2 and A3 packs together; ticking those two instead installs the same controls.

packs.name: Specific category STS-01: VLOS over a populated area (class C5)
packs.description: Declared operations in visual line of sight over a controlled ground area in a populated environment, with a class C5 aircraft. Installs the controls every operation needs, the specific-category controls, the standard-scenario controls and the STS-01 controls.

packs.name: Specific category STS-02: BVLOS over a sparsely populated area (class C6)
packs.description: Declared operations beyond visual line of sight over a controlled ground area in a sparsely populated environment, with a class C6 aircraft and optional airspace observers. Installs the controls every operation needs, the specific-category controls, the standard-scenario controls and the STS-02 controls.

packs.name: Specific category: operational authorisation (SORA or PDRA)
packs.description: Operations the competent authority authorises on the strength of the operator's risk assessment, made with SORA or a predefined risk assessment (PDRA). This is the route for a C2 flown outside the open category, since the standard scenarios need C5 or C6 aircraft. Installs the controls every operation needs, the specific-category controls and the authorisation controls.

packs.name: Specific category: light UAS operator certificate (LUC)
packs.description: An organisation holding, or applying for, a light UAS operator certificate, whose privileges may let it authorise its own operations. Installs the controls every operation needs, the specific-category controls, the Article 11 risk assessment and the LUC controls.
